why: Good look at the gate now: two yellow-striped posts with cyan top and bottom bars, gap clearly visible, roughly centered/slightly left in the forward view at heading +10deg. Last time a ~27-31deg left turn from a similar apparent position overshot the gate entirely (lost it to the right at k1). The proposed +28.8deg turn looks like the same overshoot. Overriding to advance with a much smaller left correction to keep the gap centered instead.
